page.notes: The Hebrew block at the top left is printed in parallel with the Latin column and is partly illegible in the scan; it was not transcribed word by word. The first Latin paragraph shows a stray Hebrew letter "ב" that should be checked. The Latin text in the right column of the first block was read as printed.
